body_markdown:
BrainsWay will be participating in the ISAM Global Addiction Therapeutics Innovation Day (GATID), taking place on September 30, 2026, in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.


[Dr. Colleen A. Hanlon, PhD](https://www.linkedin.com/in/colleen-hanlon/) , Vice President of Global Medical Affairs at BrainsWay, will deliver a featured presentation on the role of TMS in advancing addiction treatment.


For full event details, please visit:
[https://www.isam2026rotterdam.org/gatid-2026/](https://www.isam2026rotterdam.org/gatid-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
